overview: IITM Pravartak Technologies Foundation is a Technology Innovation Hub (TIH) funded by the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India under the National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems. Hosted by IIT Madras, it specializes in Sensors, Networking, Actuators, and Control Systems (SNACS) and focuses on technology development, entrepreneurship development, human resource development, and international collaboration. The foundation offers skill development programs such as 'Out of the Box Thinking through Mathematics' and 'Next Generation Mobile Wireless Networks' to nurture innovation and bridge academia-industry gaps.
objectives: Prepare young India for next-generation world-class technologies
Enable fundamental research to translate to products
Integrate academics, industry, government, and international organizations
Promote critical thinking and problem-solving skills
eligibility: Eligibility varies by program. For Out of the Box Thinking through Mathematics: Level 1 – School Class 5 and above (Age 10+), Level 2 – School Class 7 and above (Age 12+), Level 3 – School Class 9 and above (Age 14+), Level 4 – School Class 11 and above (Age 16+); no upper age limit. For Next Generation Mobile Wireless Networks: Familiarity with basics of networking is preferred; prior knowledge of wireless networks is not required.
benefits: Free online courses with recorded video sessions, periodic assignments and assessments, live sessions with instructors, access to Learning Management System (LMS), proctored final exams at select centers across India, grade certificates (A-D) issued by IITM Pravartak for exam takers, skill development in innovation, leadership, financial literacy, entrepreneurship, communication, and emerging technologies, hands-on labs, case studies, and industry-relevant training.
financial_support: Courses are free of charge; however, a nominal fee is charged for the final proficiency certificate examination. No financial support in the form of grants, loans, or subsidies is provided to participants.
application_process: 1. Visit the course page (e.g., https://pravartak.org.in/out-of-box-thinking or https://pravartak.org.in/next-generation-mobile-wireless-networks). 2. Click on 'Register Now' or follow the registration link. 3. Fill in the registration form with required details. 4. Submit the form to complete registration. 5. For certification, opt for the final exam during the exam registration window and pay the nominal fee. 6. Attend the proctored exam at designated centers across India. 7. Receive grade certificate based on exam performance.
deadlines: Registration Start Date: 04th May 2026; Registration End Date: 31st July 2026; Course Start Date: 7th August 2026
implementing_agency: IITM Pravartak Technologies Foundation (a Section 8 company), hosted by IIT Madras and funded by the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India under the National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems
contact_details: oobt@iitmpravartak.net | +91 9677285357 (for OOBT); enquiry@iitmpravartak.net | +91 90436 74267 (for Next Generation Mobile Wireless Networks)
caveats: Final exam carries a nominal fee; course content is accessible only until the exam date
Certification is issued only to those who take and pass the final exam
Live sessions are limited and conducted in phases during the course
Exam centers are in select cities across India;select cities across India only
Multiple levels can be registered based on eligibility, but no level is a prerequisite for another
